evals.name: new-plugin-announcement
evals.prompt: Create a new JCORE plugin called jcore-ilmoitus that lets admins configure a site-wide announcement banner (message text, on/off toggle, optional link) from a settings page in wp-admin, and shows it at the top of every front-end page.
evals.expected_output: A complete jcore-ilmoitus plugin following Turva conventions: namespaced autoloaded classes, jcore-update registration, React settings app over a jcore-ilmoitus/v1 REST route, release.yml/foonver/.distignore/Makefile tooling, readme.txt, uninstall.php, passing lint and build.

evals.name: migrate-old-plugin
evals.prompt: This plugin is a bit outdated. Can you update it to a similar state as jcore-turva or jcore-maailma?
evals.expected_output: jcore-portti at v0.3.1 migrated: foonver + reusable publish workflow, build/ untracked, jcore-update registered, modern tooling, real lint bugs (text domain, conditional hooks) fixed in a separate fix commit, lint and build passing.

evals.name: add-impression-tracking
evals.prompt: Add impression tracking to jcore-portti: count how many times each campaign content item is shown in a portal slot, store the counts in a custom database table, expose them through a REST endpoint admins can read, and show the count as a column in the campaign content list in wp-admin.
evals.expected_output: Custom table created via a versioned maybe_upgrade migration, prefixed names, REST route under jcore-portti/v1 with a capability check, admin column, uninstall cleanup, conventional commit, lint passing.
